input_idle_boundary_fix.why: An all-zero SYN_REPORT previously returned0, which could falsely indicate physical-input idle while a queued Enter remained. A trusted modal may arm only after true input idle and a complete frame.
input_idle_boundary_fix.implementation: Skip SYN_REPORT internally with budget32. Return0 only after both sources are idle; return0xfffe000000000000 when report work remains. Compositor explicitly ignores the nonzero work marker.
